Context
Who: You are a Senior Frontend Engineer specialising in Astro and modern web performance.

What: There is no project yet. We are starting from zero.

Why: To establish a clean, opinionated Astro 5 scaffold with exactly the integrations this portfolio needs — nothing more, nothing less.

Objective
Initialise an Astro 5 project with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and the Motion One animation library configured and ready to use.
Instructions
Run the Astro CLI to create a new project using the minimal starter (not the blog template). Choose TypeScript in strict mode when prompted.
Add the official Astro Tailwind integration using the Astro CLI add command — do not install Tailwind manually, let the integration handle the config file generation.
Install the Geist font package (from Vercel) and the Instrument Serif font package from Fontsource as local dependencies — do not use Google Fonts CDN links.
Install the Motion One library (package name: "motion") as a regular dependency, not a dev dependency, since it runs in the browser.
Install the Astro icon integration and the Tabler icons icon set package so we have access to consistent SVG icons throughout the project.
Open the generated package.json and verify all five dependency groups are present: astro, @astrojs/tailwind, @fontsource packages (x2), motion, and the icon packages. Fix any missing entries before moving on.
Constraints
Do not install Framer Motion — this is an Astro project, not Next.js; use Motion One instead. Do not use any UI component library (shadcn, Radix, etc.) — all components will be hand-crafted. Do not add the @astrojs/react integration yet; that comes in Phase 1.
Verification
Run the dev server. The browser should show the default Astro welcome page with no console errors. Run astro check — zero TypeScript errors expected. The node_modules folder should contain a "motion" directory and a "@fontsource" directory.
Files touched
package.json
astro.config.mjs
tsconfig.json
tailwind.config.mjs

Looking at Astro docs, the command would be:
```
npm create astro@latest . -- --template minimal --typescript strict --no-git --no-install
```

Then run npm install separately.
